geometry.note: Current geometry is source-locked; exact biological support surfaces and cable/support interfaces remain semantically open.

palette.required_correction: At site design, distinguish local/native species and functional groups from ornamental or non-native look-alikes; do not convert the aesthetic palette directly into a planting schedule.

states.label: Bare structural control
states.purpose: Zero-biological-load control state for structural and water comparisons.

states.label: Establishment / early growth
states.purpose: Early establishment state with irrigation and low-maturity biomass.

states.label: Intermediate canopy
states.purpose: Intermediate growth state for irrigation, maintenance, windage and support checks.

states.label: Mature nominal canopy
states.purpose: Long-term nominal mature state after local species, substrate and maintenance strategy are reviewed.

states.label: Mature saturated / post-rain state
states.purpose: Bounding wet-mass state including retained water in media/biomass after rainfall or irrigation.

states.label: Storm windage + saturated load state
states.purpose: Coupled windage, wet-mass and drainage stress state after environmental basis is supplied.

states.label: Maintenance cut-back / reduced canopy
states.purpose: Reduced biomass/windage operational state used for access, fire-load and maintenance comparisons.

states.label: Irrigation isolated / service access
states.purpose: Service state for access, isolation, pruning, replacement and drainage inspection.

states.label: Water-off / failed-safe biological state
states.purpose: Degraded state for irrigation/power/sensor failure; explicitly triggers dry-fuel, plant-health and maintenance review rather than assuming benign failure.

required_local_inputs: regional ecosystem / local native species evidence
First Nations / custodial review pathway where applicable
mature dry and saturated biomass measurements or defensible design data
maintenance access, pruning and replacement strategy
failure_modes: sensor or irrigation failure causing stale twin state
visual render treated as quantitative biological geometry
next_actions: Bind roof/canopy support surfaces after Watch Tower semantic geometry pass.
Create a site-neutral species-functional-group register before selecting any species.
Leave all mass, water, flow and windage values null until attributable evidence is supplied.
Couple mature-wet/storm loads into structural analysis only after support/cable semantics and environmental basis are reviewed.
